evidence: The documented synthetic repository manifest, source, three fixtures, worker-page schema and exact CLI command give a third-party developer a complete local example. The sample-cli check passes three cases; sample-conformance tests in the focused-connector check identify stable codes and JSON pointers for malformed packages, outputs, cursors and rights fields without echoing supplied content.

The focused-connector check covers the fixed three-argument worker entry point and additive keyword-only invocation context, public page schema aliases, closed scientific input, and signed sample behavior. The native-sample check executes two sample pages inside a locally test-signed real Windows LPAC worker; a malformed broker response fails closed. Static conformance alone is not used as proof of runtime isolation or current authorization.

The focused-connector check passes the expected two-page repository search and metadata paths, Core-observed per-page broker response, same-authority cursor and committed-predecessor restrictions, source-reported terms, true/false/unknown redaction provenance, publication and reopen. It also exercises changed project/package/query, unobserved cursor, malformed/extra/null scientific fields, broker errors, cancellation, restart and replay denial or recovery.

The native-sample check passes two real Windows x64 LPAC worker tests, including a malformed broker page that does not echo content. A synthetic local provider and local test-signing are used; this does not claim a live institutional repository, production signature, or external network qualification.

The exact base-to-candidate diff adds the sample and guide, public worker-page schema, Core-owned scientific parser and job/provenance changes, staged-page and native worker compatibility, synthetic fixtures and regressions. No storage migration is needed for the additive page metadata: historical redaction state reopens as unknown and new publications require an observed boolean. Accepted ADR-0027/0028 still govern authority; indexed Proposed ADR-0038 only binds three protected paths to those decisions.

The focused-connector, native-sample, packaging, generated Core API contract, architecture, ADR, build-manifest, affected Ruff/format/mypy and backlog checks pass on the same clean commit. The preexisting repository-wide quality inventory omission and stale completed-T02 grant-migration fixture are preserved as adverse evidence with separate bounded repair routes; neither is represented as a T03 pass or as W2 qualification.

The first pre-review found four content/provenance/contract defects; red-first regressions and remediation are recorded in the task-start note and replayed by independent review. Full foundation quality was attempted but fails on a preexisting CAP-05.S01.T01 inventory omission; selected affected Ruff/format/mypy pass. The broader grant-migration run finds a stale completed-T02 test fixture; no migration qualification is claimed. Full profile and cross-capability runs belong to S05 integration/checkpoint and W2 exit, after those separate repairs.
deferred: Full foundation quality is currently red on the preexisting tests/desktop/test_seed_document_drop_fixture.py inventory omission; GOV-MAINT-0026 is the bounded control-repair route. Affected T03 Ruff, format and mypy pass, but the full quality check is not represented as passing.

The expanded connector suite's two grant-migration failures are a stale completed-T02 v20 fixture after v22/v23 DDL additions. A linked correction is required before S05/W2 migration qualification; no production migration defect was demonstrated by the isolated audit.

S05 integrated slice/checkpoint and W2 exit retain the complete affected/full profiles, cross-capability denial/restart/recovery, desktop accessibility, packaging, performance and security matrix. Live provider, production code signing and external network behavior are not established by synthetic local tests.
